text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Law) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.

1A. In this Order —
“MinLaw political office holder” means —
(a)any Second Minister for Law;
(b)any Minister of State assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Law; and
(c)any Parliamentary Secretary assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Law;
“Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Law” means any Permanent Secretary to the Ministry of Law.
[S 565/2026 wef 18/08/2026]

2. The Minister for Law, with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the First Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the First Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the First Schedule.

3. The Minister for Law delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the Second Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Second Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Second Schedule.
